commit_message: Implement ADR0145 external agent provider adapters
pr_title: Implement ADR0145 first-class external agent provider adapters
pr_body: Implements ADR 0145 on current main. Adds GUI-free Claude Code and Codex external AgentRuntime adapters while preserving the generic command fallback and the existing AgentHost run/permission/workspace/validation/completion contracts. Provider-managed auth is discovered without storing provider credentials; MCP connection material remains ephemeral and local to the child process. Provider JSON streams are translated into sanitized semantic progress/tool events, provider failures are classified without persisting raw output, and Remote AI Studio receives only sanitized adapter status. AI Studio gains provider selection/auth/discovery UI with deterministic Visual Validation state.
